text: Project Ops 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 DSH 插件，通过模型工具和会话页头面板支持项目开发流程。它可发现项目声明的检查任务，按改动文件规划受影响的验证或构建任务，运行任务并生成回执，再核对回执是否与当前计划匹配。面板还汇总当前会话登记的文件，按格式分类并打开 Host 原生预览，同时列出项目计划与交付记录。适合希望在 DSH 中整理项目任务、跟踪验证结果和查看会话文件的开发者。

Project Ops adds project tools and a session panel to DeepSeek Harness. It finds declared checks, plans tasks for changed files, runs them and records verification receipts. The panel groups session files, opens Host previews, and lists project plans and delivery notes. For DSH developers.
想按本次改动的文件自动整理需要执行的项目检查任务。
我想在 DSH 里查看项目有哪些测试、构建或类型检查任务。
能不能后台跑项目任务，之后再回来收取结果？
需要确认验证结果对应当前计划和最新代码，有什么办法？
I want to browse files created during this DSH session and open them in the host preview.
Can I keep project plans and delivery notes alongside my DSH session?
Project Ops 的功能「按改动规划验证」：提交工作区相对路径和 verify、build 或 all 目标后，插件会根据受影响工作区挑选已声明任务，并返回计划摘要及诊断。
Project Ops 的功能「运行任务并核验回执」：选择已发现任务后可前台或后台执行并收取回执；验证门重新计算计划，检查回执缺失、失败或过期状态。
Project Ops 的功能「会话文件与计划面板」：从会话页头浏览登记文件和 docs/tasks 下的计划、交付记录；文件按扩展名分类，可打开 Host 原生预览或定位文件。

@missher/dsh-project-ops README · Project Ops：Project Ops is the `@missher/dsh-project-ops` plugin for DeepSeek Harness. It puts one entry in the session header: browse the files this conversation registered next to the project's development plans, open a file in the Host's native right-sidebar preview, or reveal it in Finder and hand the actual file to someone by copy or drag-and-drop.

[Desktop app](https://github.com/Missher12/Missher-DeepseekHarness-Desktop) · [Install](INSTALL.md) · [Task documents](docs/TASK_DOCUMENTS.md)

@missher/dsh-project-ops README · What you get：- **Session files**: the files this conversation registered — native `present` deliveries plus successful `write`, `edit` and `str_replace_editor` changes. The list comes from session history and may keep entries later moved or deleted; text listed in an `artifacts[]` report is not a file record.
- **Categories**: All, Plans, Word, Excel, PPT, PDF, Images, Media, Other, chosen by real extension; `plan.docx` is a Word file, never a development plan.
- **Native preview**: clicking a file name opens the Host's own right-sidebar file preview; whether content is rendered depends on the Host's support for that format.
- **Show in folder**: reveals and selects the file in Finder so you can copy the file itself or drag it into a chat window — not just copy its path.
- **Development plans**: the same panel lists this project's `docs/tasks` tasks and their "Plan / Delivery record" document entries.

@missher/dsh-project-ops README · Use it：1. Install the plugin into the target profile (see [Install](INSTALL.md)).
2. Open a session and click **Project Ops** in the session header.
3. Filter by category; click a **file name** to open the native preview.
4. Click **Show in folder** on the same row: Finder opens with the file selected; copy or drag it from there.
5. Switch to the Plans area to open PLAN / delivery records. `Escape` closes the panel; `Tab` moves inside it.

@missher/dsh-project-ops README · Categories and file sources：Categories are derived from the extension only, never from words such as "plan" in a name:

| Category | Extensions |
| --- | --- |
| Word | doc, docx, docm, odt, rtf |
| Excel | xls, xlsx, xlsm, xlsb, ods, csv, tsv |
| PPT | ppt, pptx, pptm, odp |
| PDF | pdf |
| Images | png, jpg, jpeg, gif, webp, svg, avif, bmp, tif, tiff |
| Media | mp3, wav, m4a, flac, ogg, mp4, mov, webm, mkv, avi |
| Other | everything else, including source code and text |

@missher/dsh-project-ops README · Preview, show in folder and missing files：- Clicking a file name asks the Host filesystem whether the path is still accessible before opening the native preview; a moved, deleted or unreadable file shows an inline error. Whether the file renders is up to the Host's support for its format, so not every file is guaranteed a content preview.
- "Show in folder" calls the Host's native session file-location action (`session/openWorkspacePath` with `reveal`). On macOS the Host runs `open -R`, which selects the file in Finder. The plugin never builds shell strings and never starts a service.
- A moved or deleted file keeps its row (history stays true); clicking preview or show-in-folder reports a short error so the user can deliver the file again.
- When the Host lacks file indexing, native preview or desktop reveal, only that capability is turned off with a notice; the panel and the other entries keep working instead of disappearing.
section: Preview, show in folder and missing files

text: @missher/dsh-project-ops README · Verified scope：Real install and UI acceptance this round ran on **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.4 on macOS desktop**:

@missher/dsh-project-ops README · Verified scope：These are measured anchors, not acceptance for every platform, every Host version or every model setup. This round did not cover other platforms, older Hosts or every model combination.

@missher/dsh-project-ops README · Install and update：Building a local package from the current `main` source, install, reload and removal live in [Install](INSTALL.md). Install with the desktop that matches the target profile: `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add <local.tgz>`, then reload the profile and **refresh the DSH page** to load the new client UI; confirm no load error and a **Project Ops** entry in the session header. The plugin manager's detail page reads `meta.detail` from the package's `locale/<language>.json` and shows the short intro in `docs/PLUGIN_DETAIL*.md`; the GitHub README stays detailed. Never pass an old source checkout's `lib` off as the frozen package.

@missher/dsh-project-ops README · Develop and check：```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm typecheck
pnpm test
pnpm build

On macOS, build with a Node that does not enable the hardened runtime: the DSH-bundled runtime rejects npm's unsigned native bindings (`mapped file has no cdhash`), while a non-hardened Node loads them. If a native binding crashes, remove `node_modules`, run `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` again, then `pnpm build`; a failed build restores the previous `lib` instead of deleting it.

@missher/dsh-project-ops README · Develop and check：Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`. `pnpm test` covers host capabilities, file projection and client rendering; `pnpm check:ui` checks style classes and the UI contract; `pnpm smoke:profile` installs, calls and removes the plugin in an isolated temporary profile — that is not a real model, Electron or day-to-day install acceptance.

@missher/dsh-project-ops README · History and screenshots：- 0.4.0 delivery records: [wide-Host compatibility and UI](https://github.com/Missher12/Missher-DSH-Project-Ops/blob/v0.4.0/docs/tasks/2026-10-14-wide-host-compat-5f76a32a7990cb98/READY.md) (including unverified items), [document capability](https://github.com/Missher12/Missher-DSH-Project-Ops/blob/v0.4.0/docs/tasks/2026-10-12-task-documents-44fc988/READY.md).
- The screenshots and those records are **0.4.0-era history**. They do not include this round's file categories, show-in-folder action or concise copy, do not represent current `main`, and are not release or install acceptance.

@missher/dsh-project-ops README · Tools：Host tools: `missher_project_ops_task_list`, `task_plan`, `task_run`, `task_collect`, `verification_gate`, `capability_search`, `doctor`, `document_read`, `document_write` (all prefixed `missher_project_ops_`). Execution stays with the Agent's native shell / Jobs; the plugin accepts no arbitrary commands and never replaces approvals, sandboxing or the scheduler. The verification gate re-checks receipts and source snapshots, unknown evidence cannot pass, and nothing is pushed to Git automatically.
